comments.body: I have no preference between `cloneDeep` and `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))`, the former is probably more readable, and @bobylito mentionned something about `Date`s (more info here: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/11491938/issues-with-date-when-using-json-stringify-and-json-parse )
Can you add a test for this in the Template-test.js? Where we check that the references are different

About cloneDeep versus JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()), let's wait for a performance issue before switching to it.

Also about dates etc.. We should be good since what comes from the helper is already JSON-SAFE data (= safe for JSON.parse/stringify)
Data going to transformData doesn't have this guarantee.
